items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued October 16 at 2:51AM EDT until October 19 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 8 to 12 feet expected in the surf
zone. Waves currently forecast to peak Sunday evening and
night.

* WHERE...The beaches north of Cape Hatteras.

* WHEN...From 2 PM Saturday to 8 PM EDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and
localized beach erosion.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...There is potential that high surf advisory
criteria could last through much of the upcoming work-week.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced swimmers should remain out of the water due to
dangerous surf conditions.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued October 16 at 4:34AM EDT until October 19 at 11:00AM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 45 kt and
seas 9 to 14 ft expected.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Duck to Oregon Inlet.

* WHEN...From 11 AM Saturday to 11 AM EDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...There is low confidence in the end time
of gale force conditions, as they could extend well beyond
Monday.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
